"""冻结第97轮：仅以同一KKT对象已有成功层级作为HSD下次分解的起点。"""

import hashlib
import json

assert all(sha(ROOT/n)==h for n,h in previous['archive']['members'].items())
files={n:sha(ROOT/n) for n in production['files']}; libraries={n:sha(ROOT/n) for n in production['libraries']}
assert files==production['files'] and libraries==production['libraries'] and (len(files),len(libraries))==(95,17)
assert sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')==sha(ROOT/'.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe')==production['solver_sha256']
parent=read('v98-plan.json'); math=read('v98-closeout.json'); identity=read('v98-run-identity.json')

assert sha(DATA/'v98-plan.json')=='a66d1fc30ba2cc8eb2a9a56fe1381801b6f73297fabc9e2cb8bd6ae1e2f219a2'
assert sha(parent_work/'build-manifest.json')==math['build_manifest_sha256']==identity['build_manifest_sha256']
assert sha(identity['candidate'])==identity['candidate_sha256']=='59c66991263429c21b66eba51cec6141c4c89f01b0fc4b4905d249681676874f'
assert build['math_self_tests']['ipm']['cases']==82 and build['math_self_tests']['coupled']['cases']==43
assert not list(DATA.glob('v100-build-attempt*.json')) and not (DATA/'v100-plan.json').exists()
for group in parent['sets'].values():
    assert sha(group['models_file'])==group['models_file_sha256']
    assert all(sha(m['input'])==m['sha256'] for m in group['models'])
save('v100-baseline-check.json',dict(passed=True,public_lp_runs=0,previous_goal_turn='progress',
    created_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    previous_verification_sha256=sha(DATA/'v99-closeout.json'),previous_document_check_sha256=sha(DATA/'v99-document-check.json'),
    previous_archive_members=len(previous['archive']['members']),previous_documents=len(docs['document_sha256']),
    algorithm_parent_build_sha256=sha(parent_work/'build-manifest.json'),files=files,libraries=libraries,
    solver_sha256=production['solver_sha256'],
    progress_evidence='v99完成216纯诊断及82+43真实重编译、31阶段守恒；完整91 off/on均通过，公共报告91对全等，私有仅native剩余time_limit差异仍保留。当前有效性能仍v98双方91/91、wall .138613265892/.0944576496665。CHOLMOD numeric占23.56%，coupled其余18.73%，normal_solve11.11%；下一单项复用已有成功正则层级，不同时改FG/FMA。',
    driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),driver_sha256=sha(__file__)))
plan=copy.deepcopy(parent)
plan.update(round=97,version='v100',candidate_version=100,algorithm_parent_version=98,
    created_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),kind='previous_success_regularization_seed',
    baseline_verification_file='v100-baseline-check.json',baseline_verification_sha256=sha(DATA/'v100-baseline-check.json'),
    evidence_file='v99-closeout.json',evidence_sha256=sha(DATA/'v99-closeout.json'),
    math_evidence_file='v98-closeout.json',math_evidence_sha256=sha(DATA/'v98-closeout.json'),
    parent_instrumentation_file='v98-ipm-instrumentation.py',parent_instrumentation_sha256=sha(DATA/'v98-ipm-instrumentation.py'),
    previous_candidate_plan_sha256=sha(DATA/'v98-plan.json'),
    diagnostic_environment='SOLVER_V100_PRESOLVE',diagnostic_marker='V100_PRESOLVE',coupled_marker='V100_COUPLED',energy_marker='V100_ENERGY',
    coupled_kernel_file='v100-coupled.hpp',work_directory='.tools/v100-presolve',
    algorithm_parent_coupled_kernel_file='v98-coupled.hpp',algorithm_parent_coupled_kernel_sha256=sha(DATA/'v98-coupled.hpp'),
    parent_coupled_test_file='v98-coupled-self-test.cpp',parent_coupled_test_sha256=sha(DATA/'v98-coupled-self-test.cpp'),
    hypothesis='相邻HSD系统可能重复从0试到相同正则层级；以已有最近成功level作为首试，可免重复失败分解。旧level对新矩阵也可能过强，使FG或外层更慢，必须以共同原精度和预算实测。',

    changed_source_files=['私有regularization seed与HSD调用两锚、三组组件及冻结构建/运行；纯核只namespace重绑'],

        'v100-ipm-self-test.cpp','v100-coupled-self-test.cpp','v100-build.py','v100-run.py'])

for key in ('pipeline_policy','oracle_policy'):
    plan[key]=[line.replace('V98_','V100_') for line in parent[key]]
plan['coupled_policy']=[line.replace('v98','v100') for line in parent['coupled_policy']]
plan['regularization_seed_policy']=[
    '只有新薄helper int v100_regularization_seed(const KktFactor& factor)和HSD唯一外循环factor调用两CPP字面增量。helper直接读solver_v100_coupled_state::enabled()，活动返回getter，否则原0，无预算检查/分配/扫描。',
    '同一KktFactor局部对象的regularization_level_已有状态，不增加全局/跨模型历史；getter初始化0，首次outer会继承initialize最后成功level，不能称首轮必从0开始。',
    '只在原HSD外循环处将factor.factor(diagonal,options,start,result)改为传helper实参；initialize、普通Mehrotra、方向重试、factor内部trial与所有其它caller字面保持。',
    '当前homogeneous_repair协议下，成功返回的factor已有level0..7；下一outer只在前次正常完成后启动。内部从seed继续旧递增trial直到7，层级只升不降；失败/预算后旧core退出，不重用失败过程的字段。',
    '每次仍按当前H、实际r/R重新完整装配并数值分解，旧成功level不保证新系统成功；不缓存或混用上次因子值、方向或Ddelta。',
    '活动新语义可能选择比原最小可行level大的shift，损失P精度或改变外层轨迹；完整FG/F界/comp strict/原LP q全部保持，不能由factor减少声称收益。',
    '不同时加入衰减/降阶搜索/冷回退/新重试、FMA/SIMD、旧profiling Scopes、放大资源或新启发式；关闭新ENV仍原v66公共行为。']
plan['new_cpp_labels']=['warm_regularization_seed','warm_regularization_hsd_factor']
plan['required_coupled_ipm_cases']={'warm_regularization_seed_scope':'mapping','warm_regularization_real_factor':'transaction',
    'warm_regularization_hsd_budget':'budget'}
plan['parent_required_coupled_ipm_cases']=parent['required_coupled_ipm_cases']
plan['required_regularization_seed_standalone_cases']=[]
plan['coupled_kernel_test_policy']=[
    '父43 standalone仅新kernel include/namespace两绑定，旧11 raw前缀及全部43调用顺序/数学语义保持，没有新增纯核算法case。',
    '父82 IPM固定16允许改名后保原ID/group与数学意义，新增三组共85；实际core若有新轨迹，依据真实共同质量与预算，不擅改旧断言掩盖回归。',
    '实际KktFactor可显式在高层7成功后检验非零seed、活动scope/关闭/fresh0及getter无副作用；同当前H warm只一trial且实际r/R对应该level，不假定rank1 cold必4级。',
    '新真实因子与HSD预算入口相互交叉，独立名义方程或当前storedR检查；真实HSD过期入口零factor/P/A，因子预算入口保原计数/epoch/TLS。当前没有可注入HSD预算回调，不声称穷举factor内部所有预算边界，也不为此增加运行时testhook；旧partial/public及owner合同保持。']
plan['expected_math_and_build']=dict(ipm_cases=85,standalone_cases=43,legacy_standalone_cases=11,
    preserved_standalone_cases=43,new_regularization_seed_standalone_cases=0,compiled_units=3,dependency_files=3,
    generated_sources=7,build_input_snapshots=17,inherited_cpp_anchors=35,new_cpp_anchors=2,total_cpp_anchors=37)
plan['research']=[
    dict(url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coin-or/Ipopt/releases/3.14.19/src/Algorithm/IpPDPerturbationHandler.cpp',

plan['research_urls']=[r['url'] for r in plan['research'] if 'url' in r]
plan['considered_not_implemented']='不同时做扰动衰减/降阶、FMA/SIMD/AXPY、改best/F/strict、加预算或模型路由。计时诊断不链接进本轮性能exe，原normal库保留。'
plan['historical_regularization_scope']='v30普通Mehrotra额外降级搜索、v35同轮方向重试、Ipopt/MadNLP衰减策略不是本轮HSD跨轮hold；本轮需重新实测。'

"""保存第97轮每次实际调用的源码、原始输出、退出和耗时。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('script')
parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.label.startswith('v100-') and '/' not in args.label and '\\' not in args.label
target = DATA / (args.label + '.json')
assert not target.exists()
script = (ROOT / args.script).resolve()
assert script.is_relative_to(ROOT) and script.is_file()
source = script.read_bytes()
wrapper = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
input_sources = {}
if script.name == 'v100-build.py' and '--self-test' not in args.arguments:
    for name in ('v100-plan.json', 'v100-baseline-check.json', 'v100-ipm-instrumentation.py', 'v100-coupled.hpp', 'v100-ipm-self-test.cpp', 'v100-coupled-self-test.cpp', 'v100-build.py', 'v100-run.py', 'v100-runner-self-check.json', 'v98-ipm-instrumentation.py', 'v98-coupled-self-test.cpp', 'v98-coupled.hpp', 'v93-energy.hpp', 'v92-coupled.hpp', 'v92-pretest-clarification.json', 'v66-run.py', 'v47-profile-build.py'):
        raw = (DATA / name).read_bytes()
        input_sources[name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'source': raw.decode('utf-8')}
command = [sys.executable, str(script), *args.arguments]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.perf_counter()
process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8='1'), capture_output=True)
record = {'started_at_utc': started, 'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'command': command, 'returncode': process.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.perf_counter()-begin,
    'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
    'build_input_sources_before_execution': input_sources,
    'stdout': process.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), 'stderr': process.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'wrapper_source': wrapper.decode('utf-8'), 'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(wrapper).hexdigest()}
with target.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
if process.returncode == 0 and args.arguments in (['self-check'], ['--self-check'], ['self-test'], ['--self-test']) and script.name == 'v100-run.py':
    result = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    assert result['passed'] is True and result.get('public_lp_runs') == 0
    summary_path = DATA / 'v100-runner-self-check.json'
    if summary_path.exists():
        assert json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result, '禁止覆盖不同的自检摘要'
    else:
        with summary_path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'record': str(target), 'returncode': record['returncode'], 'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}, ensure_ascii=False))
print(record['stdout'][-4000:])
if record['stderr']:
    print(record['stderr'][-4000:])
raise SystemExit(process.returncode)
